description_en: Queries the tags that are added to simple resources, such as instances, snapshots, disks, images, commands, and firewall rules
description_zh: 调用ListTagResources查询一个或多个轻量资源（实例、快照、磁盘、镜像、命令、防火墙规则）已经绑定的标签信息
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open list-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type instance --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTagResources

parameters.help_en: The client token that you want to use to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The resource type. Valid values:

instance

snapshot

customimage

command

firewallrule

disk
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型，取值范围：

instance：实例。
snapshot：快照。
customimage：镜像。
command：命令。
firewallrule：防火墙规则。
disk：磁盘
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource. You can specify up to 50 resource IDs
parameters.name: resource_id

fields.help_en: The key of the tag that you want to add to a resource. The tag key can be 1 to 64 characters in length
fields.help_zh: 轻量资源的标签键。标签键长度的取值范围：1~64
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of the tag that you want to add to a resource. The tag value can be 1 to 64 characters in length
fields.help_zh: 轻量资源的标签值。标签值长度的取值范围：1~64
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The list of tags. You can specify up to 20 tags
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表，最多包含20个标签
parameters.name: tag

NextToken.description_en: A pagination token. It can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If NextToken is empty, no next page exists
NextToken.description_zh: 下一个查询开始Token，NextToken为空说明没有下一个
NextToken.title_en: 下一个查询开始Token，NextToken为空说明没有下一个
NextToken.title_zh: 下一个查询开始Token，NextToken为空说明没有下一个
